pages.summary: These frolicking fiends carry Trick-Or-Treat Bags, and are more likely than other mobs to leave one behind when defeated. Right-click to open, and find small treats (or tricks) inside.

If fortune favors you, a Noisemaker can be found inside a Trick-Or-Treat Bag.
This terrorizing toy works like a Goat Horn, and is equipped with 12 sounds to frighten your friends.

elements.text: Is that a Creeper igniting? Did a Shrieker just activate? Is a wither on the loose? Only you will know for sure...

pages.summary: We can't forget spooky tunes to go along with the season! Find the Halloween music disc inside various loot chests.

elements.text: Enjoy supernatural symphonies and macabre melodies as you sift through your chess-monster or design your domain.

pages.summary:
Sunflower Oil

Once your Pine wood has rotted and aged to perfection, preserve it, using Sunflower Oil!

elements.text: Use on Pine Woods and Planks to stop the aging process. Note: This has a permanent effect.
